description_en: Generates a compliance evaluation report for the rules in a specified account group
description_zh: 为指定账号组内规则列表中的规则生成评估报告
kebab_example: aliyun config generate-aggregate-config-rules-report --client-token 1594295238-f9361358-5843-4294-8d30-b5183fac0000 --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --config-rule-ids cr-25d86457e0d900b50000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateAggregateConfigRulesReport

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The `token` can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of the account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。多个规则ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。
